title: Canadian woman has two NDEs, one involving a devil, and receives much guidance
content:
My first death happened when I choked on my own vomit after drinking too much. I was depressed from having an abortion four years prior. In that death, I met with what we would call the devil. He came very close to taking my soul.

Out of desperation, I called in God and Jesus to be by my side. The moment I did, the devil ran. I was then able to speak with Creator and ask him some questions before I was transported into the Black Void, the place where all illusion begins.

There, I was shown lessons about Time and how we can work with it. That experience changed me, and I turned my life around.

One year later, in 1993, I died again - this time from a heart attack. I slipped out of my body, and a huge brown bird swooped me up and carried me into the Light.

In the Light, I met with God, Jesus, and the Council of Men. I was shown so much: why we are here, who we are, and what happens to suicidal souls. I had a life review, I worked with both 9D and 12D holograms, and I was given the Five Lessons of Life - which was like an owner’s manual for the body, mind, and spirit.

I was also shown why we travel in Soul Paks and why we experience such pain and tragedy here on this PlanET. Everything was revealed to me including the vibration of our words, and how to toss negative energy into the Cosmic Garbage Can.

It was amazing - especially given that in 1992 and '93, few people knew or spoke about quantum physics, parallel dimensions, holograms, AI, ETs, the multi-verse, God is Energy, or the three Voids - Black, Grey and White.

After my NDEs, I experienced a lot of ET events. During one of these events in April of 2012, I was shown how the future human race were working with me and approximately 1000 others here to change our future. At that time, the future race lost the ability to love, have compassion and have babies. They had come back for the end of the Mayan Calendar and the beginning of AI to alter our future to ensure the human race enters a new timeline. Which we did. For the very first time, the human species on this planet did not end on Dec 21, 2012. We won a battle that few know about, but I was very much part of.

Now, I’m an award-winning international best-selling author, artist and sculptor. I love to paint, write, and explore. Every day I wake with a lucid dream and, from there, I'm given directions - including reaching out to you!
